name: claude-code-mods
description: The owner's Claude Code mods: plugins that change Claude Code's own interface or behaviour through its function-hooks API.

plugins.name: cartoon-fx
plugins.description: Cartoon animations in the conversation for accepted plans, commits, cherry-picks, rebases, pushes, pull requests opened, merges, passing tests, finished code reviews, review fixes, compaction, subagents and a context window entering the yellow and red zones.

plugins.name: possum-squad
plugins.description: A side panel that shows every agent as a tiny animated opossum dressed for its job
